about_the_game:
Football Club Inside
Every decision shapes your story.

Take control of a struggling lower-league football club and lead it through one unforgettable season — where your words, choices, and values matter as much as your tactics.

Choose your manager — a young visionary, an old-school veteran, or a charismatic outsider — then pick your starting club and begin your rise from the bottom of the football world.

In Football Club Inside, you’re not just managing numbers — you’re managing people, pressure, and belief.

🎮 Gameplay Features

⚽ Story-Rich Football Management
Experience a football narrative told through cinematic cutscenes, dialogue, and meaningful decisions. Every word, promise, or press statement affects your club’s morale, finances, reputation, and fan support.

👥 Choices That Matter
Handle player conflicts, training intensity, injuries, or scandals. Decide who to trust — the board, the fans, or your players. Your actions ripple through the season, unlocking multiple possible endings.

🏟️ Emotional Football World
Feel the highs of victory and the pressure of defeat in a grounded, character-driven story about ambition, loyalty, and belief.

🧠 Tactical Decisions on and off the Pitch
Plan your approach before each match, make key calls during AI-simulated games, and adapt to unexpected events that challenge your leadership.

🎬 Cinematic Pixel-Art Style
Beautiful, realistic 32-bit pixel visuals bring every press room, locker room, and stadium night to life — capturing the spirit and emotion of football at its rawest level.

🏆 Multiple Endings
Your leadership defines the story. Will you achieve promotion, hold the club together, or face an early dismissal?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10 capable
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 capable
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Lead a small football club through one unforgettable season. Make tough choices, face the media, manage morale and ambition — every decision shapes your story in this cinematic, story-driven football management drama.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Greek, Indonesian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
